searches.answer: In 2026, React remains the most widely used frontend library, with over 78% adoption among frontend developers, according to 2025 surveys. The web development landscape is fragmented with new frameworks like Qwik introducing resumability and AI-native frameworks gaining traction. While React is a UI library, its ecosystem has become foundational for modern web development. The industry continues to evolve with new frameworks, languages, and libraries, though the AI coding era may favor mature technologies due to extensive existing documentation and community support.
